summary: Chucklefish's Advance Wars-inspired turn-based tactics series with campaign editors, cross-play multiplayer, and later mobile/console expansion.

entries.title: Wargroove
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with Double Trouble

primary.version: Windows PC release with Double Trouble DLC
primary.why: Windows has the complete current game with the free Double Trouble expansion, flexible capture, and the same cross-play content as the console versions.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version and make sure the free Double Trouble update/DLC is installed for the added campaign, commanders, units, and editor updates.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; Double Trouble is a free expansion/update, not a separate sequel.

entries.title: Wargroove 2

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the primary route.

primary.why: Windows has the original PC release, flexible capture, editor access, and the same core content as the later Xbox and mobile ports.
primary.how_to_play: Play Wargroove 2 on Windows for the full campaign, Conquest mode, editor, and cross-play support; use mobile only if specifically covering the Pocket Edition interface.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile Pocket Edition changes device/interface context but is not a separate mainline game.
